subject: general
question: Which of the following with respect to the Modern Periodic Table is NOT correct?

options.text: The number of shells increases as we go down the group.
The elements present in the same group have same number of valence electrons.
Na, Mg and S belongs to the 4th period of the Modern Periodic Table.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Na, Mg and S belongs to the 4th period of the Modern Periodic Table**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Modern Periodic Table consists of 18 groups and 7 periods.
 
• The number of electron shells increases as we move down a group in the periodic table.
 
• Elements in the same group have the same number of valence electrons.
 
• Sodium (Na), Magnesium (Mg), and Sulfur (S) actually belong to the 3rd period of the Modern Periodic Table, not the 4th period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Periods in the Periodic Table:**

 
 
• Periods are horizontal rows in the periodic table.
 
• The period number indicates the number of electron shells in the atoms of the elements in that period.
 
 
 
• **Groups in the Periodic Table:**
 
 
• Groups are vertical columns in the periodic table.
 
• Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties and the same number of valence electrons.
 
 
 
• **Valence Electrons:**
 
 
• Valence electrons are the electrons in the outermost shell of an atom.
 
• They determine the chemical properties and reactivity of an element.
 
 
 
• **Periodic Trends:**
 
 
• Periodic trends refer to patterns in the periodic table that show the variation of certain properties of elements.
 
• Common periodic trends include atomic radius, ionization energy, and electronegativity.
